name: forgeplan-map-pack
description: Builds a navigable map of a project — zones, nodes and verified edges — as a `map.json`, through an eight-agent pipeline (scan -> extract -> verify -> emit -> validate) where every stage runs in a fresh isolated context and a deterministic guardian script, not an LLM, is the sole authority on whether the result can be trusted. Use when you need a structural view of a large or unfamiliar repository that a file tree cannot give, or when a project's forgeplan artifact graph should be shown alongside its code. Not a documentation generator: an edge is either sourced from the artifact graph or proven by a grep, and an unproven one is dropped rather than shipped as noise. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
